plain: A guest named Dr. Gilbert says that in 2023 it was reported that nematodes, tiny worms, were brought back to life after 46,000 years frozen in the Siberian permafrost, the ground in Siberia that stays frozen all year. He tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels as a point about how long life can survive in harsh conditions.
